# Vendored from τ²-bench

From [sierra-research/tau2-bench](https://github.com/sierra-research/tau2-bench)
at commit `4ce7c0397c1eb65c9bbe59aeacfe1ca44a1cd699`, under its MIT licence
(`LICENSE`, copied unchanged).

| File | Source path | Why it is here |
|---|---|---|
| `policy.md` | `data/tau2/domains/airline/policy.md` | the one prose source the AOAS was written from, kept beside it so a reader can check every rule against the text |

Nothing else is vendored. The tool code, the database (6.7 MB) and the tasks
are read from a pinned checkout outside this repository (`../fetch_tau2.sh`).
